user_query: I want to plan a trip to London and need to know the current date and time in the city. Can you provide me with the ISO8601 formatted date and time, as well as the 12-hour and 24-hour format? Additionally, I would like to know the abbreviation of the timezone and whether it falls in Daylight Savings. Thank you.

TaskList.description: Fetch the current date and time in London in ISO8601 format.
Convert the ISO8601 date and time to both 12-hour and 24-hour formats.
required_inputs: ISO8601 date and time from step 1

TaskList.description: Retrieve the timezone abbreviation for London.
Check if London is currently observing Daylight Savings Time.
